# The APEC Group

> The APEC Group is a one-stop-shop for all petroleum needs — fuels, tanks, pumps, compliance, and emergency services.

## Overview
Founded as Atlanta Petroleum Equipment Company in 1989, The APEC Group has evolved from a small service provider into an industry leader. We operate as a commercial B2B enterprise in the domestic US market (including major hubs in Georgia and Texas). We provide comprehensive, full-spectrum petroleum equipment, installation, and support services.

## Our Services
- **Gas Station Construction:** End-to-end construction and remodeling.
- **Environmental Compliance:** Compliance testing, inspections, and regulatory solutions.
- **Service & Maintenance:** 24/7 emergency response and routine maintenance for fuel systems.
- **Fuel Solutions:** Fuel delivery, tank installations, and pump services.
